integrity: The scalar strong metric dimensions are explicitly treated as prior work; only the complete all-set classification, enumerators, and counts are asserted as the new finding.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite simple generalized wheels. The finite checker covers only \(m\le4\) and \(3\le n\le7\) and is not used as the all-orders proof. The literature comparison cannot exclude poorly indexed equivalent work.
title: All strong resolving sets of generalized wheel graphs
